name: notam-briefer
description: NOTAMs in force for an airfield or along a route, in English or French, from notam.amenai.net.

interface.longDescription:
NOTAM Briefer lists the NOTAMs in force for an airfield or along a route, in English or French.

Ask for an airfield by its code, or for a route between two airfields. The answer shows the NOTAMs on a map and in a list. Each NOTAM has the coded original text. When the service's automatic interpretation passes its safety checks, a plain-language reading is shown too. When it does not pass, only the coded original is shown.

For general-aviation pilots and flight students who want to read NOTAMs more easily.

Limitations:
- NOTAM Briefer is not an official aeronautical information source. It republishes data from the FAA and EUROCONTROL, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by either.
- NOTAMs may be missing, out of date or misinterpreted. Do not use this service for flight preparation or navigation. The pilot in command must get a briefing from certified official sources.
- Some positions are approximate, and the answer says so.
- The number of briefings per period is limited. The limits may change at any time without prior notice.

NOTAM Briefer uses the same API and data as the NOTAM Briefer applications, including the web version at https://notam.amenai.net.
defaultPrompt: What NOTAMs are in force at LFPN today?
Show me the NOTAMs along my route from KPAO to KMRY.
Which NOTAMs are active at EGLF this week?

positive.description: Airfield briefing for a French airfield.
positive.prompt: What NOTAMs are in force at LFPN today?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls airfieldBriefing with LFPN and lists the NOTAMs in force. The answer shows the map and list, states each NOTAM's verified status, and carries the disclaimer and the source note.

positive.description: Route briefing between two US airfields.
positive.prompt: Show me the NOTAMs along my route from KPAO to KMRY.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls routeBriefing from KPAO to KMRY and lists the NOTAMs along the route. The answer shows the map and list, states each NOTAM's verified status, and carries the disclaimer and the source note.

positive.prompt: Quels NOTAM sont en vigueur à LFBO ?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls airfieldBriefing with LFBO in French and answers in French. The answer shows the map and list, states each NOTAM's verified status, and carries the disclaimer and the source note.

positive.description: Airfield briefing for a UK airfield.
positive.prompt: Which NOTAMs are active at EGLF this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls airfieldBriefing with EGLF and lists the NOTAMs in force. The answer shows the map and list, states each NOTAM's verified status, and carries the disclaimer and the source note.

positive.description: Paged briefing for a busy airfield.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls airfieldBriefing with KJFK, then calls it again with cursor set to nextCursor while hasMore is true. If it stops early, it says the briefing is partial. The answer shows the map and list, states each NOTAM's verified status, and carries the disclaimer and the source note.

negative.description: Weather, not NOTAMs: NOTAM Briefer must not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather at LFPN right now?

negative.description: Airline flight status, not NOTAMs: NOTAM Briefer must not be called.
negative.prompt: Is Air France flight AF7300 from Paris to Nice delayed?

negative.description: General knowledge with no live data: NOTAM Briefer must not be called.
negative.prompt: What does NOTAM stand for, and why do pilots read them?

fr-FR.subtitle: NOTAM par aérodrome ou route
fr-FR.description:
NOTAM Briefer liste les NOTAM en vigueur sur un aérodrome ou le long d'une route, en anglais ou en français.

Demandez un aérodrome par son code, ou une route entre deux aérodromes. La réponse affiche les NOTAM sur une carte et dans une liste. Chaque NOTAM comporte son texte original codé. Quand l'interprétation automatique du service passe ses contrôles de sécurité, une lecture en langage clair est aussi affichée. Sinon, seul le texte original codé est affiché.

Pour les pilotes de l'aviation générale et les élèves pilotes qui veulent lire les NOTAM plus facilement.

Limites :
- NOTAM Briefer n'est pas une source officielle d'information aéronautique. Il republie des données de la FAA et d'EUROCONTROL, et n'est ni affilié à ces organismes ni approuvé par eux.
- Des NOTAM peuvent manquer, être périmés ou mal interprétés. N'utilisez pas ce service pour la préparation du vol ou la navigation. Le commandant de bord doit obtenir un briefing auprès de sources officielles certifiées.
- Certaines positions sont approximatives, et la réponse le précise.
- Le nombre de briefings par période est limité. Les limites d'utilisation peuvent être modifiées à tout moment et sans préavis.

NOTAM Briefer utilise la même API et les mêmes données que les applications NOTAM Briefer, dont la version web : https://notam.amenai.net.
